role: @MainActor XCTest suite for StrapSignal, the main-actor continuation wake-up: fire resumes all waiters with true, timeout and cancellation resume with false, a late fire after timeout is harmless, and a fire with no waiters is not latched.

units.does: Starts a waiter Task on wait(timeout: 30), yields once, fires, and asserts the waiter returns true.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

flags.text: Ordering-dependent: the waiter Task must register its continuation before signal.fire(); the test relies on a single `await Task.yield()` to let it run. If the waiter has not registered yet, fire() finds no waiter (fires are not latched, StrapSignal.swift:18-23) and the waiter then blocks until its timeout (30 s → assertion fails) or, with timeout nil, forever (test hangs).

units.does: Starts three waiters with timeout nil, yields once, fires, and asserts each returns true.
